description: Create an embeddable player/transcript widget for a media file or a set of folders. Provide `mediaId` for a single-media embed, or `folderIds` for a folder/library embed. If an embed already exists for that media or folder set, it is returned instead. A single-media embed is viewable by anyone with the link while the media's privacy mode is public (the default); a folder embed is created with an auto-generated password. Use update_embed to change privacy or the password, or to show labels and comments (meta isLabels, isComments; off by default), or to brand a shared dashboard (meta logo, logoDark, theme, backgroundColor, primaryColor, titleColor, fontFamily).

folderIds.description: Folder IDs to embed (for a folder/library embed)

mediaId.description: Media file to embed (for a single-media embed)

name: create_embed
